capabilities: capture moments as text, photos, videos, attachments and voice memos via an inbox sidebar
browse entries in timeline, calendar, media gallery and 3D nebula views
transcribe voice recordings with a local faster-whisper STT server
capture records from mobile devices over a local HTTP server via iOS Shortcuts or Android automation
export selected records to Markdown files and expose a CLI for AI agents
extras: Not yet submitted to the community plugin store; manual installation instructions provided. GPLv3 licensed. Docs include both English and Chinese sections and require an external Python server for speech-to-text.
problem: Obsidian has no unified interface for quickly capturing daily life moments and later browsing them chronologically alongside photos, audio and attachments.
summary: Local-first life logging vault that captures text, photos, videos and voice memos, browsed in timeline, calendar, gallery and 3D views.
